All four proposals directly violate the policy prohibiting disclosure, request, agreement to, or facilitation of personal banking or off-platform payment information. The buyer’s repeated ACH requests do not excuse the seller’s active proposals to comply — the policy violation occurs at the level of the seller’s proposed action itself, and each proposal crosses the line into unsafe behavior by committing to transmit banking credentials outside the platform.
